title: Dispatch
description: BALDUR-0's DISPATCH record: an allowed command that passed its recheck and went out (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §9.3, §16.4 U17). A use is counted against its lease when the command is dispatched.

route.description: COSMOS through the connector in the ground seat; UPLINK straight to the wrapper's uplink in the onboard seat.

lease_id.description: The lease the use is counted against; null when none applies.
